2026-09-11, even later: two follow-ups from the user looking at this card live. (1) Added the back face's own real printed Flying as a fact, {event:'grantKeyword', keyword:'Flying', subject:'self', target:'self', face:'back'} — user overrode the earlier 'self-inherent keyword, no vocabulary' call ('face - for sure also source of flying, grant keyword or whatnot'), reusing the SAME grantKeyword vocabulary haste-magic/circle-of-power already use for a GRANTED keyword to model an INNATE one (user's own framing: a flying-matters payoff doesn't care whether flying is inherent or granted). No real trace evidence possible (a printed `keywords` array entry is static data, never a real grantKeyword action call) — added a new GENERAL (not per-card) verify-synergy.mjs exemption, isInnatePrintedKeywordFact, cross-checked against the card's own real declared keywords so it can't wave through a fabricated claim. Also applied the identical fix to summon-bahamut/fin-1's own identical printed Flying (flagged by the user as worth reconsidering for consistency; judged cheap/mechanical enough to just fix in the same pass rather than leave noted-but-separate). (2) Consolidated the old 5 separate flat harness.ts scenarios into ONE real, fully engine-piloted `runEngineScenarios()` (user: 'let's make 1 scenario, not 5, similar to fin 58' — mirrored jill-shiva-s-dominant-shiva-warden-of-ice's own exact real shape): cast Dion (real {3}{W} mana payment) -> real ETB (added `on:'enter'` to the front face's onEnter trigger for real 603.6b auto-fire, matching Jill's/Cloud's own convention) creates the Knight token -> real turn passage clears summoning sickness -> real {4}{W}{W},{T} transform activation -> Bahamut, Warden of Light's real Saga chapters fire over real turns (I immediately on transform, II on the next draw step, III the turn after) -> chapter III's real Gigaflare destroy (real `preferTarget`, targets a real opponent Coeurl instead of the old flat scenario's own documented self-destroy modeling-limitation finding) -> transform back to Dion. This closes out the front face's own reliance on the general isActivationCostPermanentBaselineFact exemption for self-cast/self-enters with REAL cast/enters trace evidence now (the exemption function itself stays, still legitimately used by Coeurl and any future card with the same structural shape — just no longer needed for THIS card specifically). verify-synergy.mjs (scoped + full pool 314): 0 hard failures (same class of soft notes — tapForMana/drawCard/transform mechanical scaffolding — Jill's own trace already has). vitest: 238/238. find-synergies.mjs before/after (isolated swap, both this card's new Flying fact and summon-bahamut's): 0 diff — real, documented zero-match new vocabulary usage (no other pool card wants a Flying grantKeyword sink yet), same pattern every other freshly-promoted vocabulary got this session.

2026-09-11, later: added a real self-tap COST fact to the front face, {event:'tap', subject:'self', target:'self', face:'front'} — the real {4}{W}{W}, {T} activation cost on 'Exile Dion, then return it transformed.' No trace evidence possible (engine.ts's activateAbility pays {T} silently, no log line) — covered by a new general verify-synergy.mjs exemption, isSelfTapActivationCostFact (added alongside the same fact on Coeurl, fin/12 - the only other fin/1-20 card with a real {T} in its own activationCost, checked all 20 fresh). find-synergies.mjs before/after (isolated swap): 0 diff — real, documented zero-match gap. verify-synergy.mjs (scoped + full pool 314) 0 hard failures; vitest 238/238.

Earlier: Migrated to the unified Fact model (SYNERGY_DESIGN.md). Real, checked-against-Scryfall P/T added to both faces (front 3/3, back 5/5 — missing before this pass). Wired a real `grantKeywordAll` effect for Wings of Light's 'those creatures gain flying until end of turn' (previously undone in `run()`, real text only) — now has genuine trace evidence (fn:'grantKeyword'). verify-synergy.mjs: 0 hard failures, 0 soft notes (scoped and full-pool). vitest: 238/238. Fixed a real compute-annotations.mjs bug along the way: it looked up real oracle text by `card.name` alone, which is only the FRONT face's name on a transforming CardDefinition — needed the combined Scryfall 'Front // Back' key when `backFace` is present.
knownGaps: Front face's own static 'Dragonfire Dive — During your turn, Dion and other Knights you control have flying' has NO fact — genuine engine gap, not a card-authoring omission: this engine has no execution hook for a CONTINUOUS, turn-conditional static keyword grant at all (grantKeywordAll only ever runs from inside a triggered/activated Effect; there is no 'your turn' condition check anywhere in trigger dispatch). Same class/treatment as Ardyn, the Usurper's own 'Demons you control have menace, lifelink, and haste' and ENGINE_GAPS.md's Cloud Panharmonicon entry. See ENGINE_GAPS.md's new entry.
